1.text: Pawulo wagizwe intumwa ya Kristo Yesu nk'uko Imana yabishatse, kandi nk'uko isezerano ry'ubugingo bubonerwa muri Kristo Yesu riri,

2.text: ndakwandikiye Timoteyo, umwana wanjye nkunda.Ubuntu n'imbabazi n'amahoro bibe kuri wowe, biva ku Mana Data wa twese no kuri Kristo Yesu Umwami wacu.

3.text: Imana nkorera nkurikije ba sogokuruza mfite umutima utancira urubanza, ni yo nshimira yuko nkwibuka ubudasiba uko nsenze ku manywa na nijoro.

4.text: Nibuka amarira yawe, ngakumbura kukureba ngo nuzure umunezero,

5.text: kuko nibutse kwizera kutaryarya kukurimo, kwabanje kuba muri nyogokuru Loyisi no muri nyoko Unike, kandi nzi neza yuko kukurimo nawe.

6.text: Ni cyo gituma nkwibutsa gusesa impano y'Imana ikurimo ngo yake, iyo waheshejwe no kurambikwaho ibiganza byanjye.

7.text: Kuko Imana itaduhaye umwuka w'ubwoba, ahubwo yaduhaye uw'imbaraga n'urukundo no kwirinda.

8.text: Nuko ntukagire isoni zo guhamya Umwami wacu cyangwa izanjye imbohe ye. Ahubwo ufatanye nanjye kurenganyirizwa ubutumwa bwiza, ufashijwe n'imbaraga z'Imana

9.text: yadukijije, ikaduhamagara guhamagara kwera itabitewe n'imirimo yacu, ahubwo ibitewe n'uko yabigambiriye ubwayo, no ku bw'ubuntu bwayo twaherewe muri Kristo Yesu uhereye kera kose,

10.text: ariko none bukaba bwarerekanywe no kuboneka k'Umukiza wacu Kristo Yesu, wahinduye urupfu ubusa akerekanisha ubugingo no kudapfa ubutumwa bwiza.

11.text: Ubwo butumwa ni bwo nashyiriweho kuba umubwiriza wabwo, n'intumwa n'umwigisha w'abanyamahanga.

12.text: Ni cyo gituma mbabazwa ntya nyamara singira isoni, kuko nzi uwo nizeye uwo ari we, kandi nzi neza yuko abasha kurinda ikibitsanyo namubikije kugeza kuri urya munsi.

13.text: Ujye ukomeza icyitegererezo cy'amagambo mazima wanyumvanye, ugikomeresha kwizera n'urukundo rubonerwa muri Kristo Yesu.

14.text: Ikibitsanyo cyiza wabikijwe, ukirindishe Umwuka Wera utubamo.

15.text: Uzi yuko abo muri Aziya bose banteye umugongo, muri abo ni Fugelo na Herumogene.

16.text: Umwami wacu agirire imbabazi abo kwa Onesiforo kuko yanduhuraga kenshi, kandi ntaragakorwa n'isoni z'umunyururu wanjye,

17.text: ahubwo ageze i Roma agira umwete wo kunshaka arambona.

18.text: Umwami amuhe kuzabona imbabazi z'Umwami kuri urya munsi. Ibyo yankoreye muri Efeso uko bingana, nta wukurusha kubimenya.
